info.title: Vertex Seven REST API
info.description: REST transport for the existing MCP operations. Uses the same owner OAuth grant, canonical resource /mcp, S256 PKCE, scopes, tenant and quotas. Cookie authentication is not accepted.

get.summary: Get catalogue totals and recorded business activity. No revenue or sales conversion claims.

200.description: Same structured result as the corresponding MCP tool

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked bearer token

403.description: Role, scope, origin or activation denied

503.description: Integration not configured or storage unavailable
